semantics.alias_rule: returns canonical read-only zero-stride Tensor views sharing source storage
semantics.shape_rule: folds canonical binary broadcast shape across one or more inputs
semantics.layout_rule: checked strided views with zero strides only on expanded singleton or missing dimensions
semantics.device_rule: all inputs share one canonical device and stream
semantics.numeric_rule: logical values repeat exactly without copy
semantics.determinism: input order and canonical trailing-axis broadcast
semantics.cancellation_points: at every public forward or derivative boundary, per input or reduction interval, and before publication
semantics.vjp_rule: reduces output gradient across inserted and expanded axes
semantics.jvp_rule: broadcasts input tangent through the same read-only view geometry
